test: high-protein against standard nut milk, same brand and store
claimed_product: Vinamilk Sua Hat Cao Dam, 3 listings (MKT-L04 to L06)
comparator: Vinamilk 9 loai hat, 3 listings (MKT-L01 to L03)
result: claimed product sells about one-eighth of the pair by litres but carries 28.9% of the pair's protein (our calculation: 70,295 L x 50 g against 577,152 L x 15 g); it does not outsell the standard line
confounders: Cao Dam listings are newer; counters cumulative; 24% dearer per litre; the 9-nut value has no printed basis
notes: Claim is in the product name and on the page (9 g protein per 180 ml).

test: high-protein against standard nut milk, same brand
claimed_product: Vinamilk Sua Hat Cao Dam, 3 listings (MKT-T13 to T15)
confounders: Cao Dam listings are much newer (item numbers about 278 to 279 million against 176 million)
notes: Prices from the Tiki reduced-sugar listings (361,000 and 291,000 VND per 24 x 180 ml).

test: protein-claimed soy milk against the leading unclaimed soy milk, same brand and store
comparator: Vinamilk walnut soy milk 48 x 180 ml (MKT-L15)
result: claimed product sells less than a flavoured unclaimed soy milk despite costing 39% less per litre; GoldSoy unsweetened is 8.8% of the litres of seven Vinamilk soy milks read
confounders: claim is on the product page, not in the name; flavour and pack size differ
notes: Same pattern as the kitchen channel: GoldSoy giau dam 2,609 against 5,758 and 5,828 for unclaimed unsweetened soy milks on Kamereo (ECR-06).

test: protein-claimed soy milk against the channel leader
result: claimed product sells about 3% of the pair by litres; it outsells Vinamilk walnut soy milk on Tiki (6,504 against 4,821 L)
confounders: different brands; Tiki soy milk is dominated by Fami

claimed_product: GoldSoy unsweetened (claim of 3.2 g per 100 ml on its page)
result: unsweetened sells 5.1 times (Lazada), 5.4 times (Tiki) and 3.0 times (Kamereo) the sweetened version
confounders: sugar, not protein, is the visible difference; in the same stores the reduced-sugar versions of 9-nut milk (88.8K against 4.2K) and Cao Dam (12.3K against 3.4K) outsell the unsweetened ones, so consumers do not generally prefer unsweetened
notes: Not a protein test; recorded because wave 8 used the kitchen version of this pair.

comparator_vnd_per_20g_protein: 20,800 to 35,000 at WheyShop (ECR-08); Lazada whey not computed
